artifact: Human-anchored precision for sweep-100 v4 (post ronda 4), inherited from the v3 adjudication
method: Ronda 4 only suppresses (never adds). Every v4 graded finding was matched to the v3 census by (rule,repo,file,line) and inherits its human verdict (project owner where sampled, external reviewer otherwise). Verified: 0 findings in v4 without a prior verdict; 0 findings new to v4; 0 unique v3-real findings lost (the 96->94 real count drop is duplicate copies collapsing: history add+remove of the same location, all duplicates in security-secret-in-history-2).

precision.false_mass_note: The 163 inherited-false findings carry the same human sample guarantee as the v3 measurement (0/60 reals found in the seeded false-stratum sample, Wilson upper 6%); if up to 6% of them were real, the pooled upper bound is ~40.4%.
